findings.reason: The active obligation and frozen source require exactly six materially distinct Matrix Cases. The Acceptance instead fixes an unsupported category set of positive, negative, historical_compatibility, dirty_baseline, knowledge_read_set, and closed_policy. Those categories are absent from the supplied obligation and source text. Its RED intent tests that invented category set rather than independently testing material distinction.

repairs.action: Replace the fixed six-category assertion and RED selector with assertions and a failure case that establish exactly six executed cases and source-grounded material distinction, without prescribing category names. Alternatively, amend the frozen source and obligation explicitly to require those six categories.
